MAPLE RIDGE ELEMENTARY SCHOOL

October 28, 2026

Dear Parent or Guardian of Daniel Ruiz,

This letter is to inform you that your child has accumulated 6 unexcused absences during the current semester. Under district attendance policy, a parent conference is required.

Please attend a conference with the school counselor, Ms. Grant, on Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 3:30 PM in the main office. If you cannot attend at that time, call the front office at (555) 010-8890 to reschedule no later than November 17.

Please bring any medical notes or documentation that may excuse prior absences. Interpretation services are available upon request at no cost.

Sincerely,
Attendance Office
